archetypes.name: dyn-release-flow
archetypes.rationale: Release prep data and prompt approval semantics must stay coordinated.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed release prepare helper and release skill prompt together. Focus on whether companion issue title fallback remains non-fatal, whether larch-log filtering avoids unnecessary issue lookups, and whether --approve cannot bypass the empty release-window prompt. Check the prompt still tells the operator not to read PR diffs for notes. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-gh-contract
archetypes.rationale: The new gh issue view lookup is a soft dependency in release prepare.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the new gh issue view call shape and tests. Verify the helper uses the configured repo, accepts only the intended Fixes #N prefix, and preserves TSV escaping and PR row ordering. Look for any path where malformed issue JSON or an empty title could alter release counting or fail the prepare step. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
